bias.en: Bearish · broke $199–201, testing the April lows
bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 $199–201，测试 4 月低点

read.en: Arm fell 4.5% on Nov 2 to $196.79, trading between $196.12 and $207.00 and closing near the low. It is below the rising 5-day ($218.8) and falling 10-day ($218.6), the falling 30-day ($260.8) and 100-day ($280.1) and the rising 200-day ($229.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($237.10), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: Arm 11月2日下跌 4.5%，收于 $196.79，盘中区间 $196.12–207.00，收在低点附近。股价位于上行的 5 日（$218.8）和下行的 10 日均线（$218.6）下方，也低于下行的 30 日（$260.8）和 100 日均线（$280.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$229.4）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$237.10），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The drop broke the $198.8–200.9 support (Oct 30 and May 12 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $198.8–200.9, then $207–209 (Nov 2 and Oct 30 highs, Oct 22–23 lows) and $218.6–218.8 (10 and 5-day). Support is $193.9–195 (Apr 28–29 lows), then $183.2 (Oct 2025 high) and $178.5–179.4. A close above $200.9 would target $207–209; below $193.9, $183.
